en.text: W: Hello, everyone. I'm Carmen Salazar, the airport operations director,
and I wanted to thank you for attending this press conference.
As of this week, construction on the new regional airport is proceeding on schedule for two of the three terminals.
Minor design adjustments to terminal A have put the project slightly behind schedule,
and we anticipate about two months will be added to the construction time frame as a result.
I'd also like to mention that we now have a 3-D printed model of this project! Please feel free to visit our Web site so you can view it.
